postTitle: Fee Optimization: The Silent Drag on Your Returns
topic: An adviser's percentage fee grows in euros as the pot grows

assumptions.notes: Blog: a 1% AUM fee on a €500,000 portfolio is €5,000 per year; on €2 million, €20,000. Advisers can add value through behavioural coaching, tax and estate planning, coordination; flat fee or hourly models can serve larger portfolios at lower total cost.

barStory.basis: A 1% adviser fee in euros a year, illustrative
barStory.disclosure: Illustrative. Advice can be worth its fee; fee models vary by country.

hookVariants.narration: Your adviser charges one percent. What is that in euros?

beats.narration: On five hundred thousand, one percent is five thousand euros a year.
On two million, twenty thousand. The percent stays the same; the euros grow with the pot.
Advice can be worth it, like coaching through a crash. The check: the fee in euros, what it buys, and flat or hourly options.
